title: Edges in a part of a perfect matching
statement: Let $q$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. For any part $p$ and any edge of the matching, that edge belongs to the subfamily of matching edges incident to a vertex in part $p$ if and only if it contains a vertex of the form $(p,r)$ for some $r\\in\\{0,\\ldots,k-1\\}$.
hypotheses_covered: Perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part
